description: The dataset records geochemical measurements from sediment samples collected at a single site (latitude 21.277661 ° N, longitude –104.690167 ° W, elevation 1 430 m) on 8 April 2022. Each row includes the sediment depth (0–0.185 m) and the corresponding age of the layer (0–2018.8 yr) together with a suite of elemental concentrations (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta) expressed as CLR values ranging from 0 to 1.0. Additional variables such as the icoh/coh scattering index (0–11.73), event identifier, and timestamp are provided. The data are suitable for studying temporal and spatial variations in sediment geochemistry, reconstructing depositional histories, and supporting environmental monitoring or paleo‑environmental modelling.
